description: Script for synchronizing roadmap topics and content from an external API to local markdown files, including fetching data, processing topics, and writing files.

methods.name: roadmapTopics
methods.description: Fetches official roadmap topics from external API using roadmap ID and secret.

methods.name: fetchRoadmapJson
methods.description: Fetches the full roadmap JSON data from external API using roadmap ID.

methods.name: prepareTopicContent
methods.description: Prepares markdown content for a topic, including description and resources.
